Trains to St Neots

This is the train I would look at for the Little Gransden Air & Car Show. St Neots is one of the two nearest stations, on the Thameslink line between London, Stevenage and Peterborough, with a train from London King’s Cross every hour on a Sunday. There’s no show shuttle, so I’d book a taxi from here before the day. It takes about 15 to 20 minutes to the airfield.
